properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued August 30 at 2:22PM EDT until August 30 at 3:45PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
SMWTBW

The National Weather Service in Ruskin has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Charlotte Harbor and Pine Island Sound...
Coastal waters from Bonita Beach to Englewood FL out 20 NM...

* Until 345 PM EDT.

* At 222 PM EDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 23 nm west of Moore Haven to 12 nm northeast of
Lovers Key State Park to near Bonita Shores, moving northwest at 15
knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher
waves, frequent lightning, and heavy downpours. Make sure
all on board are wearing life jackets.

* Locations impacted include...
Lovers Key State Park, Englewood, Fort Myers Beach, Boca Grande,
Manasota Key, Palm Island, Cayo Costa Island, Captiva, Sanibel,
North Captiva Island, Don Pedro Island, and Bonita Beach.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor immediately as gusty winds and high waves are
expected.

Frequent lightning is occurring with these storms. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.
properties.area: Charlotte Harbor and Pine Island Sound; Coastal waters from Bonita Beach to Englewood FL out 20 NM

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued August 30 at 2:18PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
At 218 PM EDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms along
a line extending from near Labelle to 8 miles northwest of Big
Corkscrew Island to near Vineyards. These storms were nearly
stationary.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Fort Myers, Bonita Springs, Lehigh Acres, San Carlos Park, East
Dunbar, Pine Manor, Charleston Park, Olga, Southwest Florida Airport,
Buckingham, Villas, Three Oaks, Cypress Lake, McGregor, Whiskey
Creek, Fort Myers Shores, Page Park, Page Field Airport, Alva, and
Fort Myers Villas.
properties.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Frequent cloud to ground lightning is occurring with these storms.
Lightning can strike 10 miles away from a thunderstorm. Seek a safe
shelter inside a building or vehicle.

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued August 30 at 12:16PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
At 1216 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm over
Kanab, moving northeast at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Kanab.

This includes US Route 89 between mile markers 54 and 70.
properties.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
localized flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued August 30 at 12:11PM MDT until August 30 at 2:15PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
* WHAT...Urban area, normally dry wash, and small stream flooding
caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southern Kane County in southern Utah...

* WHEN...Until 215 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Rises in small streams and normally dry washes.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1210 PM MDT, trained weather spotters reported heavy rain in
the advisory area due to thunderstorms. This will cause urban and
small stream flooding. Between 0.25 and 0.5 inches of rain have
fallen.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Kanab.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.title: Marine Weather Statement issued August 30 at 1:53PM AST by NWS San Juan PR
properties.description:
The areas affected include...
Mona Passage Southward to 17N...
Coastal Waters of Northwestern Puerto Rico out 10 NM...
Coastal Waters of Southwestern Puerto Rico out 10 NM...

* At 153 PM AST, Doppler radar indicated a strong thunderstorm,
capable of producing winds to around 30 knots, and waterspouts.
This strong thunderstorm was located over the western coastal
waters of Puerto Rico, just west of Mayaguez, moving west at 5
knots.

Locations impacted include...
Mainly open waters of Mona Passage Southward to 17N, Coastal Waters
of Northwestern Puerto Rico out 10 NM and Coastal Waters of
Southwestern Puerto Rico out 10 NM.
properties.instruction:
Mariners can expect gusty winds to around 30 knots, locally higher
waves, lightning strikes, and heavy downpours. Boaters should seek
safe harbor immediately until this storm passes.
properties.area: Mona Passage Southward to 17N; Coastal Waters OF Northwestern Puerto Rico out 10 NM; Coastal Waters OF Southwestern Puerto Rico out 10 NM

properties.title: Flood Warning issued August 30 at 9:10AM CDT until August 31 at 1:00PM CDT by NWS Indianapolis IN
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Indiana...
Illinois...

Wabash River at Riverton

.Minor flooding continues on the Wabash River at Riverton. The river
has crested. Flooding is expected come to an end on the Wabash later
tonight.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring.

* WHERE...Wabash River at Riverton.

* WHEN...Until late Sunday night.

* IMPACTS...At 16.0 feet, Some agricultural lands underwater.  A few
rural roads in Crawford County, Illinois close as water backs up
Minnow Slough.  High water affects campground at Leaverton Park in
Palestine.  A few private roads near the Gill Township levee in
Sullivan County may flood.  Water level is at the top of most
makeshift levees.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:00 AM CDT /9:00 AM EDT/ Sunday the stage was 16.6 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 10.5 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage just
after midnight tonight and continue falling to 4.7 feet
Wednesday, September 09.
- Flood stage is 15.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/ind.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 915 PM CDT /1015 PM
EDT/.
properties.area: Crawford, IL; Lawrence, IL; Knox, IN; Sullivan, IN
